analyst.summary: Maharashtra Seamless makes seamless steel pipes for oil & gas exploration and infrastructure. Sales and profit have both declined over the past year as energy-sector capital spending has slowed, and the company's inventory and receivables have built up as a result. The balance sheet remains essentially debt-free, and the company keeps a high promoter stake, but a meaningful part of current profit comes from non-core other income rather than the core pipe business, so the true operating run-rate is a bit weaker than the headline numbers suggest.
